metadata.case_name: LAI KWAN MING v. LEE YIN HING T/A KING YIP CO. AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_after: Temporary/light cleaning worker, watchman, hawker, lunch-box delivery (casual jobs), rubbish collection

injuries.description: [The Plaintiff] fell from height whilst working on 15 September 1997, resulted in displaced fracture right neck of femur. Emergency operation with screws fixation performed on the same day. Post-operatively, he was discharged on 18 September 1997 and received out-patient physiotherapy for rehabilitation. Subsequent out-patient follow up showed good fracture healing and patient only got mild residual pain on walking.

injuries.icd_description: Fracture of neck of femur, unspecified

manifestations.description: Feeling of weakness in his right hip after walking for about 10 or more minutes; can manage walking slowly for about an hour
Ache in his right hip after standing for about 4 to 5 minutes, worse if standing over 10 minutes
Right hip felt tight in the squatting position; inability to squat (as complained by Plaintiff)
Mild limitation in the end range of some directions of the right hip motion
Very mild decrease in the muscle bulk of the right thigh
Mild shortening of the right lower limb
Trace of a limp, as if trying not to weight bear on right foot (observed by Dr Chun)

treatments_received: Emergency operation with screws fixation performed on 15 September 1997
Removal of implants was carried out on 6 November 1999 on patient's request

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: He could no longer enjoy playing basketball and swimming

comparable_cases.case_name: Yu Kok Wing v Lee Tim Loi
comparable_cases.injury_description: Broke his right shin bone and fractured bones in his right ankle and his left heel. Treatment included insertion of plate into his left heel and bone grafting; external plates and pins were used for right ankle.
